summary: Refresh complete episode exports and remove snips no longer present, while rejecting incomplete or malformed exports.
reason: Upsert-only pulls leave deleted snips in the local store and search index indefinitely.
validated_outcome: Local store tests show that refreshed episodes lose deleted snips and their search entries, while other episodes remain untouched. Incomplete batch and malformed template tests reject unsafe deletion sets.
safety: Before writing, the ZIP must contain each requested episode once, with the same snip count as export metadata and the expected template fields. Reconciliation starts only after validation and every returned snip is stored.
